project: Weave Self-Iteration ObjectSet Composer Semantic Search
description: Small Ralph self-iteration for branch ralph/self-iteration-20260519-122726. The previous active PRD belonged to ralph/self-iteration-20260519-090653 and all stories were passing, so it was archived under scripts/ralph/archive/self-iteration-20260519-123148/. No PR CI auto-fix context was present in progress.txt. Kickoff health: latest main CI runs 26076080948, 26069761127, and 26068337937 completed green; local sampled checks `npm --prefix web test -- --run src/lib/__tests__/objectSetBuilder.test.ts` and `go test ./pkg/oss/objectset ./cmd/server -run 'TestExecuteNearestNeighbors|TestBuildEmbeddingProvider|TestDefinition_ValidateNearestNeighbors'` passed. Dogfood DOG-001 through DOG-005 have committed regression coverage, and known fresh-CI risks around cmd/server/embed.go and US-453 streamless binary responses are covered. This PRD focuses on removing stale ObjectSet composer limitations so upper-layer users can exercise backend-supported OSv2 semantic search and exact-set definitions through the Web experience.

userStories.name: Enable nearestNeighbors in ObjectSet composer
userStories.description: Update the Web ObjectSet composer so users can select and configure the backend-supported nearestNeighbors ObjectSet variant instead of seeing a stale unsupported validation error.
bdd_acceptance: Given the ObjectSet composer is open for an ontology with object types, When the user switches the root node to nearestNeighbors, Then the composer creates an inner base ObjectSet, exposes controls for embedding property, neighbor count, and query text, and keeps the Execute button disabled only until required nearestNeighbors fields are filled.

Given a user configures nearestNeighbors with property `embedding`, K=3, and text query `find similar incidents`, When the composer updates its definition, Then the wire ObjectSet contains `propertyIdentifier.property.apiName`, `numNeighbors`, and `query.text.value` in the shape accepted by the backend executor.

Given a saved or shared nearestNeighbors definition is loaded, When it is converted to the editable node tree and back to wire format, Then the definition round-trips without throwing and validation no longer reports nearestNeighbors as unsupported.

userStories.name: Round-trip static ObjectSets in composer
userStories.description: Allow saved and shared static ObjectSet definitions to render and round-trip in the composer instead of throwing as unsupported.
bdd_acceptance: Given a static ObjectSet definition with object type and primary keys is loaded from a saved query or URL, When the composer renders, Then it shows editable object type and primary key controls instead of crashing.
Given the user edits the static primary-key list, When the definition updates, Then the wire ObjectSet preserves a stable `primaryKeys` array with blank entries removed.
Given a static ObjectSet is valid, When validation runs, Then Execute is enabled and no unsupported-type error is shown.

userStories.name: Protect composer against backend ObjectSet variant crashes
userStories.description: Add source-level and UI coverage so shared ObjectSet definitions using backend-only variants degrade to explicit read-only validation states instead of throwing during definitionToNode.
bdd_acceptance: Given a shared ObjectSet URL contains an asType, interfaceBase, interfaceLinkSearchAround, or methodInput definition, When ObjectSetPage parses it, Then the page renders a clear unsupported-editing validation state instead of throwing an uncaught error.
Given a backend-only variant is displayed read-only, When validation runs, Then Execute remains disabled with a specific message naming the variant.
Given future ObjectSetDefinition union members are added, When the source contract runs, Then the composer contract fails unless the variant is either editable or intentionally degraded.
